1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is __light-activated__.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube __and is light-activated__.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the __bottom of the test tube__, oriented for reading downwards, __and is light-activated__.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __and the MTP is light-activated__.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and is light-activated__.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__ __and is light-activated__.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, such that the racks/test tubes are handled at -20 C or less, __wherein the MTP is light-activated__.

(Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising embedding a __light-activated__ MTP in plastic or comprising heating the __light-activated__ MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated __light-activated__ MTP.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded __light-activated__ MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded __light-activated__ MTP; and reading the __light-activated__ MTP __using light activation__.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20 C or less.
